titulo: Canceling Tuesday for a Saturday plan
caption:
Canceling Tuesday for a Saturday plan

She canceled on Tuesday for a Saturday plan, and her friend thanked her.

A cancellation with days to spare lets the other person use the time, and it lands softer than the same news an hour out.

For whoever cancels with time to spare.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a small phone standing on the right. A ink-black block figure with white eyes and narrowed eyes walks up from the left and a bubble says can't do Saturday. The phone vibrates and a bubble says thanks for telling me! The figure opens its eyes wide, then its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me canceling an hour before, to: told them days ahead. they were glad.
